title: DHW-path space multi-start anchors its seeds on the smooth guess, not the thermostat demand: two-zone DHW plans miss the basin
claim: On the two-zone DHW solve at winter_typical and winter_moderate prices, the plan HeatPumpOptimizer._solve_space ships scores 1.043 and 1.066 objective units (1.18 % and 1.00 %) above a feasible plan the same call reaches from one extra bang-bang seed, and the gap closes to 0.285 at winter_typical when that call gets the space-only path's thermostat-anchored seeds.
mechanism: _optimize_space_only builds its bang-bang seeds from baseline_energy, the energy of the thermostat reference (_compute_baseline_power), and adds _DEEP_LOW_ENERGY_START_FRACTION on two-zone. _solve_space (the DHW path, through _relaxed_plans) builds them from energy = sum(min(init_base, headroom))*dt, where init_base is the smooth price guess p_max*0.6*weights clipped to [0.5 p_min, 0.8 p_max]: on winter_typical two-zone that is 51.2 kWh against the 68.5 kWh the shipped plan uses, so its 0.35x anchor sits at 17.4 kWh, and it has no thermostat seed and no deep anchor. The winning challenger seed is bang-bang at 0.35 x the plan's own energy (24 kWh), which no DHW-path candidate brackets.

evidence.unit: objective units (SEK-equivalent at price_weight 1); 1.178 % of the call's objective; shipped plan energy cost 60.58 SEK/day
evidence.machine: box B1, 4 vCPU shared by up to three finder seats
evidence.contention_note: two other finder seats running; the value is an objective difference, contention-immune

perturbation.change: race.py --perturb thermostat-anchor (in memory, wrapping _multi_start_minimize): a DHW-path call also gets the thermostat seed_power of HeatPumpOptimizer._compute_baseline_power and bang-bang at 1.0, _LOW_ENERGY_START_FRACTION and (two-zone) _DEEP_LOW_ENERGY_START_FRACTION of its energy -- the space-only path's seed set
perturbation.observed_value: twozone-dhw-24h gap winter_typical 1.043 -> 0.285, winter_moderate 1.066 -> 0.835, winter_extreme 0.483 -> 0.464, winter_narrow 0.392 -> 0.305, flat 0.256 -> 0.256; dhw-48h winter_typical 0.139 -> -0.017, winter_extreme 0.151 -> -0.081; over the 64 DHW-path cells sum 5.513 -> 3.640, cells > 0.1: 15 -> 12 (anchor.py)

metric_definition: f_prod - f_best on the captured _multi_start_minimize call's own objective/args/bounds; f_best = best challenger passing bounds, pins, comfort and DHW-floor parity
phenomenon_property: Every multi-start call that ships a space plan must carry seeds that bracket the optimum's energy: anchors scaled from the house's thermostat demand (and the two-zone deep anchor), not from an initial guess's arbitrary energy -- in every solve path, DHW and space-only alike.

null_control.value: seeds-challenger gap at flat 0.041 (vs 1.043 winter_typical, 1.066 winter_moderate); the anchor perturbation leaves flat unmoved (0.256 -> 0.256)
null_control.note: The seed-closable gap is price-driven: it vanishes at flat prices. The residual 0.256 flat gap is reached by the DE-polished challenger, not by seeds; it is not this mechanism.

reproduction_steps: PYTHONPATH=tests/hastub ~/venv-ci/bin/python3 dev/audit/rounds/round11/D0/s1/anchor.py twozone-dhw  (gap after the perturbation)
proposed_fix_scope: optimizer.py:HeatPumpOptimizer._solve_space's initial-solve seed set: anchor the bang-bang seeds on the thermostat demand the space-only path uses (one shared seed builder for both paths), add the thermostat seed and the two-zone deep anchor; add two-zone DHW cells to tests/optimality.py:_CERT_CELLS so the DHW seed set is guarded. Energy money is mixed: the winter_typical winner is 0.60 SEK/day cheaper on energy, winter_moderate's buys comfort at +3.99 SEK energy; the gain is on the shipped objective.
